description: This is a React component for a login page in a web application, handling user authentication, input validation, and related modal dialogs.

classes.name: Login
classes.description: A React component that renders a login form with validation, handles login requests, and manages associated modal dialogs for password reset.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component state and binds event handler methods.

methods.name: onClickLogin
methods.description: Validates inputs and triggers login request if valid.

methods.name: onEmailChanged
methods.description: Updates email state and validation flags when email input changes.

methods.name: onPasswordChanged
methods.description: Updates password state and validation flags when password input changes.

methods.name: onPasswordResetClicked
methods.description: Handles password reset request and shows reset modal.

methods.name: isEmailInvalid
methods.description: Determines if the email input is invalid based on validation flags.

methods.name: isPasswordInvalid
methods.description: Determines if the password input is invalid based on validation flags.

methods.name: sendLoginRequestIfCredentialsAreValid
methods.description: Triggers login request if email and password are validated.

methods.name: sendLoginRequest
methods.description: Performs the login HTTP request and handles success or failure.

methods.name: renderLoginError
methods.description: Renders an error message if login fails.
